reasoning_steps: The wire is folded so that every part is equally long.
Since the wire is 10 cm long, each part after folding will be 10 cm / 3 = 3.33 cm.
The wire is then cut through in the two positions marked.
The first cut creates two pieces of 1 cm and 9 cm.
The second cut creates two pieces of 1 cm and 8 cm.
Therefore, the three pieces created are 1 cm, 3 cm, and 6 cm.
